Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Yason Wyrar: 38-year-old woman, 176 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: broad oval face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; broad low bridge, full lips; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: wrapped contrasting band. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: a narrow tattoo cuff; a patterned collar insert; one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: practical grooming with one carefully perfected detail. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: one shoulder leads subtly and the gaze meets the viewer without a smile. Include a worn spool of colored thread only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
